events.title: The confirmation of the Council of Trent
events.shortBlurb: Pope Pius IV confirmed the decrees of the Council of Trent, sealing the reform that would shape Catholic life for four centuries…
body: On 26 January 1564 Pope Pius IV solemnly confirmed the decrees of the Council of Trent, which had met over three periods between 1545 and 1563 to answer the Protestant Reformation and to reform the Catholic Church from within. His approval was set forth in the bull Benedictus Deus, and to him was reserved the authoritative interpretation of the council's decrees.

Trent had defined Catholic teaching on Scripture and tradition, original sin, justification, and the sacraments, and had ordered the training of priests in seminaries and the reform of the clergy. The Tridentine reforms, and the Roman Missal and Catechism that flowed from them, governed the life of the Church until the twentieth century.
